lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: My Lord.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: In thy mind, which spirit emits the most alluring siren's bid?
The sweet taste of your lips, fresh with a drink.
Free booze?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: I see thy ebullience hath improved since our last meeting.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Now that, I cannot refute!

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: I am ranking every last spirit I hast imbibed in all mine days,

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: and am in a tangle as whereto shall be the victor.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: In thy opinion,

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: which dost thou find dance most aptly upon the taste buds?
Any alcohol, so long as it's with a good company as you.
Free booze is the best booze, bar none.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Haha! It seems thou hast already partaken in some indulgences

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: in mine absence today.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Nevertheless, I am pleased to hark such honeyed words.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Quite correct.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: I feel that alcohol tastes sweeter when it's free.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Haha

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Talking about alcohol with thou

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: hath made me crave for a drink.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Perhaps I truly like to hast a drink together with you.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: It hath been many a moon since we last drank.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: I shall bring over some spirits if thou are not opposed.
I will be waiting.
